title: Rabbit Rotation
description:
An introductory cryptography lab intercepted this ROT13-encoded phrase from a fictional terminal:

```
gur juvgr enoovg
```

The instructor asks you to recover the plaintext.
objective: Decode the phrase and submit it as HC{plaintext_with_underscores} (lowercase, spaces replaced by underscores).

hints.text: ROT13 shifts each letter 13 places. Applying it twice restores the original.
